issues.detail: The Hebrew 'עֶגְלַת בָּקָר' means 'a heifer of cattle' (a young cow), not '一隻母牛' (one cow). The term 'עֶגְלַת' specifically denotes a young female calf, not a general cow. Also, 'וּשְׁתֵּי צֹאן' means 'two sheep' (two individual animals), not '兩群羊' (two flocks of sheep). The Chinese mistranslates the number and type of animals.
